name: prompt-benchmarking-sandbox
description: A static, zero-build PWA for benchmarking cost, latency, and quality across LLMs side by side.

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const req=['index.html','manifest.json','sw.js','chart.umd.min.js'];const missing=req.filter(f=>!fs.existsSync(f));if(missing.length){console.error('Missing required file(s):',missing.join(', '));process.exit(1);}console.log('Build check passed — all required static files present.');"
